The '''Republic Supply Center''' was a two-story building located in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Operational Headquarters|Operational Headquarters]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] during the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Several [[Merchant/Legends|merchants]] set up stalls within the building during the war, with [[Bonne]], an equipment vendor, and [[Vineau]], a weapons modification merchant, working out of the ground floor. [[Zavery]], a [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorrean]] who sold specialty goods, worked alone from a stall on the second floor.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Republic Supply Center first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', an [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. The location also appeared on maps in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Explorer's Guide]]'' by [[Prima Games]].
